tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations vary only u_now; vmax and rho are collinear. The specified discriminating probe provides wide s_grad leverage and distinguishes the open branch.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the square-root siphon branch to pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fixed s_grad makes vmax and rho unidentifiable, so pilot fit cannot support generalization.
The open-branch probe directly supplies the missing s_grad leverage at lower cost.
It does not resolve the identified branch and parameter ambiguity.
